title: Verify physical controller debug navigation on Linux
changes: Record a real controller navigation case in the Debug integration matrix.
validation: A user pressed the physical D-pad down on a Generic X-Box pad connected to Linux. The isolated paused interpreter session observed a real joystick axis event and the Debug selection advanced from Start debug session to Start interpreter debug copy; state hash, registers, keys, frame and clock remained unchanged. Screenshots before/after were reviewed, protected public synthetic inputs remained unchanged and the GUI closed normally (dbg27-physical-pad-ready-gz_yasxx).
An earlier session timed out without physical activity (dbg27-linux-physical-pad-x3e2zrpt); this is retained as a timeout, not attributed to a product failure.
limitations: One physical D-pad navigation case on Linux/Xvfb using an existing Linux binary does not establish confirmation/cancellation, other controllers, native Windows, or current-source rebuild equivalence.
